messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High 5xx spike detected on production gateway -> error-rate: 11.8% (1m). Paging oncall. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gateway-5xx

alice: seeing a big bump in 5xx from region-us-east-1, tilt at 09:23 UTC. Dashboard -> /dash/request-errors top path: /v1/infer

ben: confirming, nginx metrics show increased 502/504 upstream failures, but envoy logs have a lot of x-envoy-upstream-rq-timeout and 503 from upstream cluster: model-serving-pool

carmen: placing oncall handoff: i'm primary until 09:45, then chris takes. Carmen here, taking lead now. What are initial mitigations?

alice: i've already shadowed route weights for a canary shard to 0.1 to reduce traffic to the shard showing timeouts. No rollback yet.

dave: repro: curl -I -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT'
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream response timeout"}
```

ben: digging envoy route config. I see our LB retry policy was recently loosened in the last deploy: retries: conditional on 5xx and gateway-error with num_retries: 2 -> now 3. That could amplify transient spikes into overload.

carmen: good catch. Can you paste the virtual_host config?

ben: snippet:
```
route: /v1/infer
  retry_policy:
    num_retries: 3
    retry_on: 5xx,router,gateway-error
  circuit_breakers:
    thresholds:
      max_connections: 2000
      max_pending_requests: 500
```

alex: (via DM) quick note: upstream model-serving-pool has been OOMing on some instances, behavior aligns with higher latencies causing retries which cascade.

carmen: mitigation plan: 1) reduce retry count to 0/1, 2) raise circuit-breaker headroom (lower max_pending_requests) or better set for per-cluster throttling, 3) divert some traffic to fallback model variant. Who can patch Envoy config?

chris: i can push a quick patch to edge-proxy config and trigger a rolling restart of gateway pods. I'll scale down retries to 1 and add per-route retry budget: retry_priority: "global" -> actually set to none.

dave: before restart, let's apply a temporary route weight shift to route to fallback cluster: /v1/infer -> 60% fallback-model, 40% primary. That should reduce load on the failing cluster without full rollback.

alice: doing weight change via control plane now: kubectl patch traffic-split gateway-config -p '{"spec":{"routes":[{"path":"/v1/infer","weights":{"primary":40,"fallback":60}}]}}'

incident-bot: Deploy started by alice at 09:28 UTC. Smoke tests will run.

ben: after weight shift, 5xx dropped to ~6.2% in 30s. Good. Still seeing intermittent 504s from the primary cluster.

chris: pushing envoy retry change now. Patch gist: https://internal.gist/patch-envoy-retry-1777
```
- retry_policy:
-   num_retries: 3
+ retry_policy:
+   num_retries: 1
+   retry_on: "reset,connect-failure"
```
Applying via CD: ./deploy/edge/update-envoy --cluster gateway --config patch-1777

incident-bot: config-rollout: gateway-envoy -> in-progress (3/3 pods reloaded)

carmen: monitoring latency and errors, also notifying support to prepare customer comms. Any known customers impacted?

eve: support: saw increased tickets in the last 15m from two enterprise customers in US-EAST. Customer Impact Sheet updated: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1777777000/impact
- impacted_percent: ~8% of requests for those orgs
- first report: 09:25 UTC
- customer visible errors: 502/504 during infer calls

ben: after envoy patch completed, 5xx down to 1.4% and request latency median back to baseline. We'll continue to observe for 15m before full rollback of weight.

alice: running post-change checks: quick end-to-end test against primary returns 200 OK on 9/10 attempts. Not perfect but stable.

dave: follow-up: we should tune circuit-breaker thresholds to avoid sudden drops. Current max_pending_requests=500 was too high for node memory; lowering to 200 and setting max_requests_per_connection to 100 could help.

chris: agree. I'll open a PR to adjust cluster thresholds and add canary tests to prevent retry-policy relaxations from sneaking in. PR: https://git.internal/infra/edge/merge/6321

carmen: handoff: i need to go, chris you're taking page. Summary to hand off:
- root cause: combination of upstream model instance instability (OOM/timeouts) + recent envoy retry loosen config causing retry amplification
- immediate mitigation: route weight shift (60% fallback), reduced retries to 1, rolled envoy config -> reduced error-rate from 11.8% -> 1.4%
- action items: chris to roll circuit-breaker tuning + follow PR for automated canary checks; infra to dig into model-serving OOMs; support to send interim customer notice

chris: ack, taking over. I'll continue to monitor for 30m and coordinate with model infra. tagging @dave for model infra deep-dive.

dave: starting model infra postmortem ticket and heap dump collection on affected instances. Logged as I-1777777000.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> mitigated (partial). Postmortem owner assigned: dave. Next update due in 2h.

alice: note for postmortem: capture change that increased retries (deploy ID: deploy-2026-04-11-887) and add a gating test for retry_policy diffs.

eve: sending customer comms draft for review: "We experienced elevated errors on inference endpoint; mitigation applied; follow-up postmortem will be shared."

chris: monitoring: last check 09:39 UTC -> error-rate 0.9% sustained. I'll mark as under observation and close page if stable at 10:05 UTC.

carmen: thanks team. great quick mitigation.

incident-bot: Page closed by chris at 09:45 UTC."
